title: A failed source or a field without owner wording is never an owner question; the brief routes it as not shown with its reason
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/brief-item-routes.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail count.
expect: A brief whose missing list holds a failed source has no owner question for it and lists missing.source:<id> under notShown with the reason.
A missing field with no owner wording has no owner question and is listed under notShown; a field with wording keeps its question.
evidence: 28/10/2026: a brief revision on the develop surface asked the owner about source:google-maps failed: HTTP_429.
fence: ownerQuestionsOf asks only fields in ASK; routesOfBrief routes the rest as not shown. Not exercised: the readiness report in a live revision.

tests: a source that failed is a research problem: no owner question, routed as not shown with its reason
a missing field with no owner wording is never asked with its raw id, it is routed as not shown
a missing field with owner wording keeps its question
